L1 | 1. Dik: Hotel memiliki 20 kamar kosong. Setelah check in tidak ada kamar lagi, setiap turis memiliki kamar sendiri.
L2 | Jawab: Jenis fungsi: injektif
L3 | Jumlah turis: 20
reasoning: The 20 tourists are right, but because every room is filled the mapping is also surjective, so it is bijective; the student names only 'injektif'.
Takes the median 15, gets n = 30 and the range 30 - 5 = 25, matching the key.

L1 | Jari-jari bola = 14 : 2 = 7 cm
L2 | Luas permukaan 1 bola = 4 x 22/7 x 7^2 = 616 cm^2
L3 | 2 bola = 2 x 616 = 1232 cm^2
L4 | Sisa gel = 1300 - 1232 = 68 cm^2
reasoning: Computes 4πr^2 = 616 for one ball, doubles it and subtracts from 1300 to get 68 cm^2, matching the key.
The products f·x are computed, but then their difference (8) is given instead of computing the mean (0) and the variance Σf(x - x̄)^2/n = 16/5 = 3,2.
Subtracts to 21/4 and divides by 3/8 by multiplying by 8/3, getting 14 bags, matching the key.
The 10% increase is added as 10 tons instead of 10% of 180 = 18 tons, so the target is 190 instead of 198.
10/3 x 3/5 = 2 is already the answer, but the student multiplies by 3/5 again and gives 1 1/5.
